title: After a godot crash while project is running, restarting godot and pressing "Run Scene" takes around 10 minutes to launch the project
body:
### Tested versions

v4.3.stable.official [77dcf97d8]

### System information

Godot v4.3.stable - Linux Mint 22 (Wilma) - X11 - GLES3 (Compatibility) - Mesa Intel(R) HD Graphics 620 (KBL GT2) - Intel(R) Core(TM) i3-7100U CPU @ 2.40GHz (4 Threads)

### Issue description

I was in the process of typing a comment on a script while my project was running when godot suddenly crashed. It pretty frequently crashes on my laptop so I just ignore it and start it up as usual, but this time I found that the project window no longer appears when I press run.

I tried:
- Pressing reload the played scene
- Pressing run currently selected scene
- Redefining the main scene
- Deleting the .godot folder
- Restarting Godot
- Signing out and in again
- Restarting the computer
- Pressing run instead of edit in the launcher
- Reextracting a clean download of godot and trying all of the above steps again

More information:
ps ax | grep project_name returns:
2733 ?        Ssl    0:30 /home/user/Documents/Godot_v4.3-stable_linux.x86_64 --path /home/user/project_name -e res://scenes/main_menu.tscn

And the debugger:

2794 ?        Dsl    0:11 /home/user/Documents/Godot_v4.3-stable_linux.x86_64 --path /home/user/project_name --remote-debug tcp://127.0.0.1:6007 --editor-pid 2733 --position 433,236 res://scenes/main_menu.tscn

Launching Godot from the terminal shows no errors whatsoever
The terminal doesn't show any errors when the project finally launches either

Viewing the remote scene tree in the Godot editor shows a completely blank tree (until the project finally shows)

Other projects launch just fine almost immediately. They are of the same complexity on the same rendering engine.

Once I wait out the 10 minutes, trying to launch the project will be instantaneous again.

### Steps to reproduce

- Have a project running
- Wait for godot to crash
- If the godot editor is gone but the project isn't, and the project doesn't respond to the x button, you got it
- Sometimes launching the project that godot crashed on will take 10 minutes to launch

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

Here's one of my projects in question that sometimes exhibits this behavior:

[MRE.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/19509790/MRE.zip)
